prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop homepage concept preview, 1440×1000 landscape
Primary request: Redesign the current TravelCanvas first viewport as an immersive dark aurora experience while preserving the exact Route-first Canvas product structure. This is a visual concept only, not a poster.
Input images: Image 1 is the current implemented homepage and must provide the real content hierarchy, Chinese copy, form density, two-column proportions, and warm-paper component character. Image 2 is the approved Route-first Canvas reference and must provide the planning-left / large-map-right topology and trustworthy travel-product feel. Do not copy its fake route or POI facts into the initial state.
Layout: slim top header; asymmetric desktop grid with a 36–40% left planning column and 60–64% right persistent journey canvas. Left column contains the brand, large editorial headline, short supporting copy, three trust cues, then a compact light rice-paper planning panel with origin, destination, date, days, travelers, a collapsed advanced-options row, and one full-width primary button. Right column is a large rounded journey canvas showing an honest unqueried abstract destination overview with no connected route and a small waiting-status pill.
Scene/backdrop: full first viewport uses a deep pine-green-to-midnight teal sky with large soft aurora ribbons, plus a photorealistic but deliberately non-specific mountain range, conifer forest, and reflective lake along the lower portion. The landscape is decorative atmosphere only and must not imply a real destination, Provider image, or verified travel fact.
Style/medium: premium production-grade Chinese travel planning web UI, sophisticated editorial typography, restrained luxury, crisp semantic controls, realistic browser-ready interface design.
Color palette: midnight pine #071b19, deep tea #17483f, tea green #1f6255, muted cyan #5faeaa, pale aurora mint #b7e2cf, tiny restrained terracotta #d96e4f, rice paper #fffdf8. Preserve green as the action color. Avoid neon purple dominance.
Typography: large local Chinese serif display headline and compact Chinese sans-serif UI.
Constraints: retain all functional regions and familiar proportions from the current homepage; planning form must remain highly legible on an opaque warm rice-paper panel; header and hero text must pass strong contrast; the journey canvas should remain visually distinct from the aurora background; no fake map route, no fake hotel price, no testimonials, no analytics dashboard, no sidebar navigation, no device mockup, no browser chrome, no watermark.
